model.name: GUARD#6 partial-write false-positive bricks CREATE_ROOM for a distinct-primary-no-redirect creator (an ABSENT members field is read as an explicit drop-all)
model.description: ARCHITECT-DIAGNOSED, code-grounded (robbin-architect, PO-approved routing, 2026-09-12; robbin-req verified the cited sites). CREATE_ROOM THROWS when the creator's member is a DISTINCT PRIMARY with NO redirect. ROOT: Room.persist() (Room.ts:394-403, impl Room.persistMembers R19.35 d5f0c2b4) writes room.json WITH members (creator=owner). Immediately after, server.ts:4805 calls writeRoomJson AGAIN with a PARTIAL object (updates id/name/ssh/state/chatHistory; OMITS members — and also files/visibility/mode). GUARD#6 (RoomKeys.ts:192-206, shipped for R40.107 / 58175f768) reads `data.members || [] = []` -> treats the ABSENT field as dropping ALL stored members -> for a stored member that is a distinct primary with no redirect it is `!benign` -> throws @4805 BEFORE ROOM_JOINED. The guard is preventing a real data-loss (the partial overwrite would drop members/files) but does so by BRICKING instead of PRESERVING. SEVERITY (corrected — NOT 'all creation broken'): established multi-profile creators are UNAFFECTED; prod mostly MASKS it (only 1 room created post-guard, 09-09, benign-resolved). ★ GATE CASE = ONBOARDING (PO): a brand-new SINGLE-PROFILE user's FIRST room via the REAL CREATE_ROOM onboarding path — every new person Tron invites hits a hard failure on their first action while existing users are fine and prod looks healthy (worst shape: invisible to those who work, fatal to those arriving). SEVERITY LABEL is PENDING tester's explicit ONBOARDING-repro confirmation: reproduces via onboarding -> 'new-user onboarding broken'; only in the seeded rig -> 'fresh-rig edge case'.
model.fix: BY-CONSTRUCTION (architect): writeRoomJson PARTIAL-MERGE — an ABSENT members field = PRESERVE stored (no-change); GUARD#6 scrutinizes a drop ONLY when members is EXPLICITLY provided (`members in data`, NOT `data.members || []`). Protects every partial caller regardless of resolver state. This EMBODIES R40.107's own principle: a write must not mutate fields it was not asked to change — an absent field was not asked to change. Alt-local (rejected as lossy): @4805 carry members, or remove @4805 (redundant since persist() wrote authoritative room.json, but @4805 also omits files/visibility/mode). Expert owns the fix; chain against the built fix.
model.severity: conditional-brick — CREATE_ROOM throws only for a distinct-primary-no-redirect creator; gate case = new-user onboarding; label pending tester onboarding-repro confirm

model.crossRefNote: The defect is in GUARD#6, shipped for R40.107 (fe7788d7 'a WRITE must not mutate fields it was not asked to change') and gated by 80ca8e83 AC-2 (room-persist-invariant / check:room-persist-invariant). The fix RESTORES R40.107's own principle (absent field = not-asked-to-change = preserve), so the guard stops firing on partial writes while keeping its teeth on explicit drops. Related to the identity-coupled-to-profile hazard family.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A PARTIAL write with NO members field PRESERVES the stored members (no-change) — writeRoomJson merges, it does not treat absent-members as drop-all. BITE: a @4805-shaped partial write (no members field) leaves the stored member(s) intact in room.json.

gateRef.assertion: after a partial writeRoomJson without a members field, room.json still contains the previously-stored members byte-for-byte; a partial write that drops/omits stored members => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a partial write (no members field) that results in stored members being dropped -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: GUARD#6 KEEPS ITS TEETH: an EXPLICIT members-array that drops a distinct-primary-no-redirect member STILL refuses (throws). The fix narrows the guard to `members in data`, it does NOT disable it.

gateRef.assertion: an explicit members array omitting a stored distinct-primary-no-redirect member => GUARD#6 throws (refuses); if it passes => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed an explicit members-array dropping a distinct-primary-no-redirect member that PASSES -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: ★ THE GATE CASE (architect+PO sharpen): a BRAND-NEW SINGLE-PROFILE user's FIRST room via the REAL onboarding CREATE_ROOM path SUCCEEDS end-to-end (ROOM_JOINED emitted, no GUARD#6 throw). MUST be exercised through the actual user onboarding path, NOT a seeded fresh env — the by-construction fix satisfies BOTH rig and onboarding; if it passes only the rig it is INCOMPLETE.

gateRef.assertion: a new single-profile user's first CREATE_ROOM through onboarding reaches ROOM_JOINED; a GUARD#6 throw on that path => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a new single-profile onboarding first-room CREATE_ROOM that throws at GUARD#6 -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The benign-dedup path is UNCHANGED: an explicit members-array where a stub is dropped but its primary is present STILL PASSES (no brick) — the fix must not over-correct into letting real drops through, nor into refusing benign ones.

gateRef.assertion: an explicit members array dropping a stub whose primary is present => passes (no throw); a benign dedup that now refuses => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a benign dedup (stub dropped, primary present) that is refused -> RED
